And what I mean by that is the book is very much laugh a minute, cram as many jokes in there as possible, and then the songs, for the most part, are very earnest. And they're more like traditional musical theater songs where it's like, now we're going to have the character sing about their thoughts were feelings in that moment. And there's not a lot of jokes in them. And so when you have a book that's, like, constantly laugh a minute, and then you kind of go into a song that's more earnest, there's a bit of a tonal disconnect. To have these songs just, like, take a moment to breathe and, like, really get to know the characters, I think actually does serve the show really well. But it was something I was not expecting because it is so untraditional in a musical comedy. But overall, for first preview, the show is in fantastic shape.
